rows: Make sure the unit to be worked on is isolated.
Stop the pump and close the discharge valve.
Start the standby cooling water pump.
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority; the maintenance team must hold an occupational safety and health category card.
Record the names of the workers on the work order and their occupational safety and health categories.
Cordon off the work area and place the appropriate warning signs.
Workers must wear occupational safety and health tools while carrying out the work, such as helmet, gloves, masks and protective shoes.
Set of open-end and ring wrenches, sizes 12 to 46 mm.
Set of screwdrivers, Allen key set from 4 to 12 mm.
Lead hammer, copper hammer and a plastic one.
Measuring tools: vernier caliper, depth gauge, micrometer set from 0 to 220 mm, dial gauge with stand, measuring tape, spirit level.
Fine and coarse sandpaper, silicone, thermal Milkote.
Suspended crane (hoist), suspension wires, sanding and grinding machine.
Disconnect the motor electrical terminals and lift it from its base.
Remove the motor base and lift it.
Sling the lower coupling half of the pump and remove its Allen screw, then lift it.
Drain the oil of the thrust bearing seat and remove the oil chamber cover.
Sling the shaft and remove the clearance-setting nut carrying the shaft.
Remove the upper cone carrying the bearing seat.
Remove the cover of the last pipe carrying the packing.
Disconnect the discharge connection from the line.
Sling the pump from the front and back at four points, then lift it with the crane.
Place support beams, fasten them well, then load the pump on them.
Disconnect the pump discharge by removing the 36 mm bolts, then remove the first pipe under the discharge.
Sling the pump and lift it, then remove the support beams, then lift the pump up to the flange of the second pipe.
Place the loading beams, fasten them, and load the pump on them.
Sling the shaft and remove the first coupling, then lift the guide bearing seat.
Sling the pump from pipe No. 2, remove the loading beams, and lift the pump.
Place the beams under the diffuser, load the pump, then remove pipe No. 2.
Sling the shaft, then remove the lower coupling, then lift shaft connection No. 2.
Sling the last pipe and remove its bolts with the diffuser, then lift it.
Remove the diffuser, sling it, and take it out.
Sling the rotating shaft with the impeller and lift it, then sling the impeller vane angle and lift it.
Inspect the bearing bushes (fixed and rotating) and replace as necessary.
Inspect the cone above the impeller.
Inspect the impeller vane angle and its fastening, and replace as necessary.
Lock the impeller vane angle and set the spindle to zero position.
Clean the pipe contact surfaces and wash the bearing seat.
Assemble and adjust the impeller vane angle, then fit the shaft with the impeller on the fixed part.
Fit the diffuser and connect it to the impeller vane angle holder, and apply silicone on the contact surfaces.
Sling the shaft and take the total clearance by setting the impeller in the lower position then the upper position, then sling the previous assembly, remove the beams, and lower the pump.
Place the beams and lower the pump, then place the bolts as it approaches the beams, then complete lowering the pump.
Fit the lower bearing seat.
Sling the fixed shaft connection, then fit the coupling.
Fit the second pipe, tighten the bolts, and apply silicone on the upper contact surface.
Sling the pump, lift the beams, lower the pump, then place the beams.
Load the pump on the beams, then fit the last bearing seat, then sling the shaft connection, then fit the last coupling.
Lower the last pipe connection, then lower the discharge and fasten it.
Fit the cover carrying the gland and the gland cover, then lower the pump, then place it on the base and fasten it.
Fit the cone carrying the thrust bearing seat.
Level the pump horizontally, adjust the total clearance of the pump, and adjust the operating clearance.
Place the motor base and adjust it with the shaft axis using a holder.
Fit the lower half of the coupling, place the motor, and measure the coupling clearance.
Lift the motor and adjust the coupling clearance by placing or removing shims under the pump base.
Level the motor base horizontally by placing shims under it.
Connect the discharge, then connect the pump base, then the motor base, and align the motor with the pump, then fasten the motor.
Place the packing and oil for the thrust bearing seat.
Connect the main motor terminals, then start for testing.
